description: Hotspot-first, multi-pass code review for pull requests, branches, pasted diffs, and work-in- progress changes. Models behavior changes, selects risky hotspots, acquires minimal local context, generates candidate findings and questions, runs a skeptic pass and dedup, then surfaces at most 5 high-signal outputs. Persists a per-run JSONL trace and per-PR SQLite ledger under ./.logbooks/code-review/. Invoke for any concrete review request: "review PR #123", "deep review", "check this diff", "review current branch", "review staged changes", "review codebase", "audit this repo", "review this repo". Do not invoke for vague opinion requests that have no diff, code, or concrete review target ("what do you think of these changes?", "any concerns?", "thoughts on this?") — requests like "check this diff" or "feedback on this PR" are reviewing tasks even without the word "review".
